paper_title: Sound of Dark Matter: Searching for Light Scalars with Resonant-Mass Detectors
notes: Paper proposes resonant-mass detectors to search for scalar/modulus DM coupling to electron mass (d_me) and electromagnetic gauge (d_e). The hint suggests ScalarElectron; both d_me and d_e are constrained on a single plot (Fig. 1). Y-axis is log10(d_i) vs scalar mass. Most results are SNR=1 projections (Cu-Si sphere, DUAL, quartz, AURIGA recast), with the Earth breathing mode giving an actual 95% CL limit |de+dme| < 2.5e-4 at f~8.1e-4 Hz (mass ~3.4e-18 eV). However, the main proposal results are projections. No tabulated numerical data points are available for digitization from this text. Could equally be classified as ScalarPhoton (d_e); paper constrains both, hence reduced confidence. | Vision: Plot shows d_i (both d_e and d_me) vs m_phi. Lower boundary traced is the strongest d_e exclusion: Dy d_e (dysprosium spectroscopy, purple) at low masses (m_phi < 3e-18 eV) merging into EP d_e horizontal bound (~3e-4) at higher masses. EP d_e = 2.98e-4 quoted in text. Coupling type is ambiguous between ScalarPhoton (d_e) and ScalarElectron (d_me) since both are on the same axis; chose ScalarPhoton as the traced (lowest) boundary follows the Dy d_e curve. Confidence reduced accordingly. | Calibration: Spot-check calibration: verify/stage2 ratio=50.0x
